relationships.subject: HU-308
relationships.evidence_quote: While a single intranasal administration of HU-308 (30 nmol) failed to reverse cold hypersensitization, repeated intranasal administration significantly alleviated cold hypersensitization (Figure 2A).

relationships.subject: HU-308
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, repeated intranasal administration of HU-308 suppressed the activation of Sp5C microglia in IONC mice.

relationships.subject: SR 144528
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, pretreatment with the CB<sub>2</sub> antagonist, SR 144528, significantly blocked the anti-nociceptive effect of repeated intranasal administration of HU-308 on cold hypersensitization in IONC mice.

relationships.subject: HU-308
relationships.evidence_quote: Repeated intranasal administration of HU-308, a selective CB2 agonist, significantly alleviated acetone-induced cold hypersensitivity and attenuated microglial activation in IONC mice.

key_findings: Repeated, not single, intranasal HU-308 alleviated cold hypersensitivity in infraorbital nerve cut mice, more effectively than oral dosing
The CB2 antagonist SR 144528 blocked the HU-308 effect on behavior and Sp5C microglial activation
